info.title: Studio99 Indic Typography API
info.summary: The typography engine for Indian scripts.
info.description:
Studio99 is the typography engine for Indian scripts. It lets creative apps, designers and AI generate exact, beautiful Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati and English text as editable artwork.

The API returns exact, editable Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati and English text as SVG and PNG. Two write paths:

- **POST /generate**: hand it a phrase, get back several styled calligraphy variants (the engine picks fonts and composition).
- **POST /render**: hand it a phrase and a `fontId`, get back that exact rendering.

Read paths (`/fonts`, `/library/search`, `/capabilities`, `/health`) are free. Metered calls cost 1 credit per variant or output.

Plans: Free 100 credits/month · Basic ₹999 for 500 · Starter ₹2,999 for 5,000 · Growth ₹9,999 for 25,000 · Enterprise custom.

Rate limits: Free: 5/min · Basic: 20/min · Starter: 20/min · Growth: 60/min · Enterprise: 120/min.

Text can be typed in the target script (Unicode) or in Latin letters ("shubh vivah"); the API transliterates when a language is given or detected.

post.description: Returns up to `count` styled variants of the phrase, each as an editable SVG (plus PNG if requested). Costs 1 credit per variant returned. Text length up to 150 characters on paid plans; `count` is capped at 6. Omit `language` to auto-detect. Use `use_case` and `mood` to steer font selection semantically. Free-plan calls return a watermarked JPG `preview` instead of SVG/PNG.

get.description: No key needed. Static metadata for AI agents and integrators: languages, formats, semantic vocabularies, endpoints, MCP URL.

BearerAuth.description: The same API key, sent as a Bearer token.

Usage.description: Monthly allowance meter, returned on metered calls. Consumers of this API are billed in credits: 1 credit per variant returned by /generate, 1 credit per output from /render, 1 credit per library download.

monthlyUsed.description: Credits used so far this billing month.

monthlyLimit.description: Monthly credit allowance. -1 means uncapped (Enterprise contract or internal channel).

remaining.description: Credits left this month. -1 means uncapped.

unit.description: Present when the credits model is enforced.

creditsCharged.description: Credits debited by this call (credits model only).

license.description: Licence that applies to the returned assets. Free-plan output is a watermarked preview with no commercial licence.

PreviewJpg.description: Free-plan preview: a small watermarked JPG with no commercial licence. Upgrade for clean SVG/PNG.

LibraryItem.description: An Inkora library artwork (ready-made text art).

text.description: The phrase, in the target script or in Latin letters.

format.description: "png" adds a `png` object to each variant alongside the SVG.

pngWidth.description: Target PNG width in px (clamped to your plan's ceiling).

fontId.description: Pin every variant to one font (from GET /fonts).

lines.description: "auto" (default), 0/1 for a single line, or 2–6 to force that many lines (typogen-x).

lineGap.description: Extra vertical gap for left/right aligned layouts (typogen-x).

seed.description: Same seed + same input = same output (typogen-x).

resultText.description: The Unicode text actually rendered (after transliteration).

path.description: The glyph outlines as a single SVG path `d` string.

archetype.description: Recipe used: plain | flagship | duo | free (typogen-x).

libraryResults.description: Matching Inkora artworks. Only returned to first-party channel keys.

objectMetadata.description: Engine metadata (fontId, resultText) when the artwork can be re-rendered.
